note: STARTER SCAFFOLD, not the launch benchmark. docs/EVALUATION.md calls for 20-50 manually reviewed real websites before commercial launch. These three synthetic fixtures exercise the harness machinery end-to-end (schema validity, ref integrity, repeatability, latency/cost telemetry) but were authored for this repo, not scraped and reviewed from real sites, so they cannot stand in for the unsupported-claim-rate or usefulness/copy-quality manual-review gates in docs/EVALUATION.md §3-4. Extend this manifest with real captured+reviewed sites (Tier B fixtures under tests/fixtures/sites/<site>/) before using eval results as a launch gate.
